journey.name: Discard a saved reply while offline
journey.description: Start: the Mailflare v2 inbox is open and signed in, online, with a newly delivered conversation at the top of the list and no draft replying to it. Discarding a reply the server already has, while offline, must close the reply, put the reply buttons back and say "Draft discarded.": closing a reply reloads the conversation, which cannot happen offline, and that failed reload must not replace the confirmation with "You appear to be offline." (#44). The discard is queued and removes the draft once the connection returns.

actions.action: Tap the first conversation in the inbox list
Verify that the conversation opens with "Reply", "Reply all" and "Forward" buttons below the message
Tap the message body of the reply and type "Offline reply"
Verify that the reply reads "Saved" within a few seconds
Swipe down from the very top edge of the screen twice to open Quick Settings, and tap "Airplane mode" to turn it on
Verify that the trash can button is visible on the screen and not covered by the keyboard; hide the keyboard with the Back button if it is covered
Tap the trash can button to discard the reply
Verify that the reply closes, the "Reply", "Reply all" and "Forward" buttons are shown again, and "Draft discarded." appears near the bottom of the screen
Verify that "Draft discarded." is still shown and the banner at the top reads "Offline" followed by "1 change waiting"
Swipe down from the very top edge of the screen twice to open Quick Settings, and tap "Airplane mode" to turn it off
Close Quick Settings and wait 15 seconds
Verify that the banner is gone
Tap the menu button at the top left of the screen and tap "Drafts" in the drawer
Verify that no draft replying to that conversation is listed in Drafts
